exact_passage: A bounded linear map $T:E\to F$ of Banach spaces is **Fredholm** when its range is closed and both $\ker T$ and $F/\operatorname{im}T$ are finite-dimensional; its index is $\dim\ker T-\dim(F/\operatorname{im}T)$.  A $C^h$ map $P:\mathcal X\to\mathcal Y$ between countable-base Banach manifolds is Fredholm of index $m$ if every $dP_x$ is Fredholm of index $m$.  A value $y$ is regular if each $x\in P^{-1}(y)$ has surjective derivative (vacuously if the fibre is empty).
